copy.hero: We build practical systems that help people and businesses make clearer choices, execute complex transactions and turn ideas into products.
copy.portIntro: Three portfolios. One way of building.
copy.portDesc: From judgment to transactions, from ideas to products. We turn complexity into repeatable systems.
copy.why: More information does not always lead to better decisions. More options do not always make choosing easier. AP structures the complexity that remains between information and action.
how: Bring domain knowledge into the process.
Turn one-off know-how into repeatable workflows.
Build systems that can improve through use and outcomes.
copy.global: Our products are designed from the start for multiple markets, languages, currencies and policies. Separating core product logic from market configuration and local integrations is a company-wide principle.
copy.globalNote: This is our design principle and expansion direction, not a claim that every product already operates in multiple countries.
copy.marketTitle: A reusable core. A versioned Market Pack.
copy.market: A versioned bundle of configuration, content and partners connects the core to a new market. Local review and pilots come before expansion.
copy.marketReview: Market research → expert and policy review → testing → pilot → activation → review
copy.decisionDesc: We organize context, explain trade-offs and keep people in control of important decisions.
copy.selectKo: See it. Try it. Understand it. Choose it.
copy.expert: Experts are external knowledge partners, not simply sales staff. We design collaboration around criteria, evidence standards, professional boundaries and standard operating procedures.
copy.expertBoundary: General product decision support is distinct from a licensed professional consultation. We do not use regulated professionals’ names as sales endorsements or imply advisory relationships without confirmed agreements.
copy.gameDesc: Learn through competition and play. Turn creative ideas into products. We focus on three projects and use real usage and outcomes to guide expansion.
copy.rgrgTitle: One core. Many ways to learn.
copy.rgrg: Learner locale, instruction language, target language or subject, and Quiz Pack are separate. The same core can support languages, certifications, education, culture and workplace learning: a global learning game and platform.
copy.pairs: Illustrative language pairs, not a list of launched packs.
copy.creator: The young creator imagines worlds, characters, stories, skills, bosses, events and fun. AP handles technical feasibility, QA, balance, safety, privacy, monetization governance and release.
copy.assetsTitle: What remains after the work is done.
copy.assets: Our long-term direction is to accumulate data, processes, expert knowledge, software, IP and customer relationships through use. Outcomes inform the next improvement.
copy.origin: Across industries, complexity often remains between information and action. AP Holdings was created to turn that complexity into repeatable systems.
copy.founderTitle: Experience as capability. Independently built assets.
copy.founder: Experience in commercial operations, global sales, tourism and international business, data analysis, product building and decision workflow design informs how we build.
copy.firewall: AP code, accounts, domains, documentation and product IP are maintained independently. Employer confidential data, customer information, operational information and IP are not AP assets.
copy.vision: Build systems that become more valuable through use, learning and outcomes.
copy.labDesc: Independent apps and small experiments by the founder. A record of building and learning, separate from the three core portfolios.
copy.evidenceNote: Execution evidence based on founder-provided build/release history and existing app links. This is not a claim of product-market fit or large-scale traction.
copy.contact: Let’s discuss product and technology, expert advisory, brand and commerce, global distribution, education and content, craft and artist collaboration, and pilots.
copy.irTitle: Complexity into systems. Execution into evidence.
copy.irIntro: Explore our investment thesis, building capability and validation plans. We distinguish current productization evidence from business outcomes still to be verified.
copy.investThesis: Reduce the recurring complexity between information and action across industries. Turn learning from use into reusable products, processes and IP. Three portfolios apply the same principle to different problems.
copy.proofTitle: AP Revenue · Decision Intelligence Working Proof
copy.proof: An independently developed Decision Intelligence Working Proof / Productization Candidate. It tests how complex commercial data can become explainable priorities, human actions and measurable outcomes.
copy.proofNote: A productization candidate, not evidence of external pilots, revenue or validated business outcomes.
demoSteps: A person decides whether to act.
copy.demoNote: A conceptual workflow illustration. No live operational dashboard, customer data or employer data is displayed.
copy.liaEvidence: Early owned-distribution experiment. Learning from Instagram/TikTok content and international audience response.
copy.futureTitle: The next proof comes from external outcomes.
copy.future: External pilots, active users, transactions, revenue, repeat and outcome. Only verified metrics will be shared, with detailed evidence supplied during investor diligence.
milestones: Working proof, existing app assets, public standards and market-aware design principles.
Planned external pilots, usability tests, expert review and audience-intent validation.
Connect actions, transactions, returns, repeat usage and outcomes to improve product and operations.
Expand products after Market Pack, local partner, policy and unit-economics validation.
copy.milestoneNote: These are planned validation stages, not completed results or committed launch dates.
copy.roadmapTitle: Built in Korea. Designed for the world.
copy.roadmap: Prioritize validation of LIA’s audience and commerce intent in Vietnam. Assess Japan, Taiwan and other markets against product fit and local readiness. Craft transactions in France are a research direction; we do not launch every product in every market at once.
copy.publicDesc: Company overview, investment thesis, Global-by-Design, portfolio, founder capability and roadmap. This webpage is the current public material.
copy.shareDesc: Full investor deck, investment memo and verified traction appendix. Shared separately following a request.
copy.ndaDesc: Financial model, cap table, contracts, legal documents, detailed IP and private metrics are managed through a separate controlled-access process.
copy.requestNote: Review and send your request in your email app. Materials are not automatically downloaded or sent from this page.
copy.legacySafe: The existing Safelist app is evidence of building. Its currently available features are distinct from the broader AP Safe product concept.
copy.copyFail: Select the address and copy it manually.
copy.connectorNote: The existing connection address is preserved. Available functions depend on the connector’s current status.
copy.connectHelp: Enter the address below in your client’s remote-connector settings. Check that client for compatibility and authentication requirements.
copy.assetNote: Existing project artwork. Features and release plans for products in development may change.
copy.rgrgAssetNote: Existing character assets preserved under the RGRG brand.
copy.termsBoundary: Product, transaction and professional-service availability depends on launch status and applicable market policies.
copy.curationNote: Existing product visuals for content. Confirm availability, price and delivery terms with the selling channel.

products.name: AP Safe
products.desc: Connects user-explicit conditions and product information to identify conflicts and conditions that need attention.
products.note: Product-information decision support. Not medical diagnosis or a guarantee of safety.

products.name: AP Light
products.desc: Compares candidates against the criteria that matter to the user, explaining trade-offs so people can understand what fits them.
products.note: Choice support that explains preferences and evidence. It does not replace professional judgment or medical consultation.

products.name: AP Revenue
products.tag: From revenue data to revenue decisions.
products.desc: An independently developed productization candidate connecting complex commercial data to explainable priorities, human action and outcomes.
products.note: Independently developed Decision Intelligence Working Proof / Productization Candidate.

products.name: AP Travel
products.desc: Connects aviation, tourism, demand, FX, supply and calendar signals to market context and opportunity. Designed around Origin × Destination × Segment × Window for decisions across markets.
products.note: Not limited to inbound travel to one country. Market-specific capabilities and data coverage will be determined through validation.

products.name: AP SELECT
products.desc: A store where people see, try, understand and choose. Connect AP Safe, AP Light, expert knowledge and physical experience, then take the customer’s choice to online ordering and fulfillment.
products.note: Concept & system design. This does not claim an operating store or currently available professional consultation.

products.name: Global K-Commerce
products.desc: LIA and content help international audiences discover products. AP Commerce and marketplaces are designed to connect discovery to purchase, fulfillment and repeat purchase.
products.note: Initial plans use marketplace and partner infrastructure while building audience, curation, content, attribution and outcome data. Market and platform availability will be confirmed at launch.

products.name: AP K-Craft
products.tag: Korean craft, ready for the world.
products.desc: Structures complex global craft transactions, from master artists and works to provenance records, export review, packaging, logistics, delivery and condition checks.
products.note: AP designs processes that connect and coordinate specialist partners. We do not claim to directly provide official appraisal, insurance or customs services.

products.name: LIA
products.role: AI Influencer / Global Korea Discovery IP
products.desc: LIA is an AI Influencer creating Instagram and TikTok content about Korean culture, places and products. A Global Korea Discovery IP connecting audiences with AP Commerce.
products.note: Early owned-distribution experiment. LIA is an AI-generated digital persona operated by AP.

products.name: RGRG
products.desc: RGRG is a learning game built around competition, goals and character growth. Learner language and target subject are separate, enabling multiple language pairs and educational content.
products.note: Continuing development of the existing project. Language, certification, education, culture and workplace-learning packs are expansion directions.

products.name: Hangeul Cubs
products.desc: A media engine extending the existing Korean-learning app into Shorts, YouTube, Korean culture and travel. Learning content and instruction language are separate for global learners.
products.note: Existing app links and product screens are preserved. Expansion into Shorts, YouTube and other media is planned.

products.name: LAST WAVE
products.desc: Imagined by a young creator. Built for the world. AP turns a young creator’s imagination into a product, with responsibility for production, quality, safety and operations.
products.note: In development. Unnecessary personal details about the young creator are not disclosed.
